test_pooling_max: test the pooling method with Pooling.MAX to compute max pooling over variable-length sequences
test_pooling_mean: test the pooling method with Pooling.MEAN to compute mean pooling over variable-length sequences
test_pooling_last: test the pooling method with Pooling.LAST to extract the last token embedding from variable-length sequences
test_pooling_mean_none_padding: test the pooling method with no padding mask to handle uniform-length sequences
test_pooling_extra_dims: test the pooling method with extra dimensions to verify broadcasting over additional tensor axes
